title: The Moon Is Collect
summary: Red rotary, taut cord to a huge moon, empty chair, abandoned gloves. Someone is calling collect; the charges are astronomical; she stepped out. Liliane energy.
visualArc: Red plastic on black lacquer → cord out the window → moon as the other party → empty gloves.
